class.name: LuaScriptRunner
class.brief_description: Runs a pure Lua gameplay script without requiring a GDScript wrapper.
class.description: Attach this native Node to a scene and set script_path to a .lua file. The runner executes the file on ready, then calls optional global _ready() and _process(delta) functions. The same native Lua runtime is compiled into editor and export templates when the lua module is enabled.

method.name: get_runtime
method.description: Returns the LuaRuntime used by this runner.

method.name: get_script_path
method.description: Returns the .lua file executed by this runner.

method.name: set_script_path
method.description: Sets the .lua script path, typically res://scripts/player.lua.

members.member: Lua source file executed when the node enters the scene tree.
